# BrushBlend <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Brushes](Blitz3D-Brushes)

</div>


```blitzbasic
BrushBlend:Void brush:Int32, blend:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | In | Int32 | required | The brush. |
| `blend` | In | Int32 | required | 1, 2 or 3. |

## Description

Chooses how painted surfaces are mixed with what is already on the screen: 1 alpha (the default), 2 multiply, 3 add. Any other number selects the default.
